title: FOUNDATIONS OF DATA SCIENCE
description: Designed to provide an introduction to data science for sophomore SEAS majors. Combines three perspectives: inferential thinking, computational thinking, and real-world applications. Given data arising from some real-world phenomenon, how does one analyze that data so as to understand that phenomenon? Teaches critical concepts and skills in computer programming, statistical inference, and machine learning, in conjunction with hands-on analysis of real-world datasets such as economic data, document collections, geographical data, and social networks. At least one project will address a problem relevant to New York City
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: MATH UN1101 and MATH UN1102 MATH V1101 AND MATH V1102; Some familiarity with programming.
raw_title_text: ORCA E2500 FOUNDATIONS OF DATA SCIENCE. 3.00 points .
